component.name: Súlimo
component.summary: Local, battery-disciplined LLM inference engine with GTK4 and Libadwaita

description.p: Súlimo (Arda's Breath) is an offline, privacy-first local LLM inference client built from the ground up in Rust for modern Linux desktops. Specifically engineered for resource-constrained laptops—from 5th to 10th generation Intel processors (Broadwell through Comet Lake / Ice Lake) with integrated GPUs—Súlimo enables seamless conversation with state-of-the-art open models without overheating or draining your battery.
Unlike conventional monolithic runtimes that aggressively spin CPU cores or keep GPUs at high power states, Súlimo features an asymmetric thermal and battery scheduling architecture:

ul.li: Asymmetric Scheduling: Uses integrated GPU OpenCL FP16 SIMD8 hardware acceleration for prompt prefill, then shifts token decode to physical CPU cores with AVX2+FMA while allowing the iGPU to enter RC6 deep sleep.
Hard 5.2 GB Unified Memory Budget: Enforces a strict static arena ceiling, ensuring models run smoothly alongside the desktop without triggering Linux OOM killer or swapping on 8 GB host systems.
Zero-Allocation Hot Path: Zero heap allocation during autoregressive decoding, backed by high-performance Q4_0 SoA weights and quantized Q8_0 circular KV caches.
Smooth 60 FPS Native Interface: Responsive Libadwaita UI with frame-budget rendering that coalesces streaming tokens to prevent stutter, paired with intelligent scroll-pause detection.
Real-time Arda Telemetry Bar: Live monitoring of unified RAM consumption against budget limits, active execution phases, generation speeds (tokens/sec), and estimated system package power draw.

description.p: Everything runs 100% locally and offline on your computer. No cloud accounts, no subscriptions, no data telemetry, and no network dependencies.

Version 0.3.0 major release: integrated Model Hub and dedicated 30 GB SSD model pool, support for Qwen 2.5, Google Gemma 2, Liquid AI LFM, and OpenBMB MiniCPM architectures, resumable cryptographic streaming downloader, and Libadwaita Model Manager dialog.

Version 0.2.0 release introducing the native GTK4 and Libadwaita client application, hybrid asymmetric battery scheduling, OpenCL FP16 Gen8–11 acceleration, and zero-copy GGUF static arena integration.
